array.string: set -a; source "$HOME/.config/stock.env"; set +a; cd "$HOME/Projects/goodnight_site/stock" && python3 tag.py "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR" --limit 40 && python3 export.py "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR" --target adobe --out "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR/_batches/adobe-$(date +%Y%m%d)" && ./upload_adobe.sh "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR/_batches/adobe-$(date +%Y%m%d)" && python3 export.py "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR" --target freepik --out "$STOCK_IMAGES_DIR/_batches/freepik-$(date +%Y%m%d)"
